title: NA40033: Marine Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Choice of Propulsion Systems â Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, Diesel Engines,
Electrical Propulsion and combinations; Marine Boilers â Oil fired, Coal fired,
Nuclear; Power Transmission System â Shafting System; HFO, MDO and LO storage,
transfer and purification systems; FW and SW systems; Firefighting and BW
systems; Sludge control and oily water purification systems; Electrical load
calculation, power generation and distribution systems; Cargo handling â dry
break-bulk, unitized and bulk cargo, liquids in bulk, cryogenic liquids etc.;
Pumps, piping and valves; Life saving and fire fighting systems; Steering and
navigation systems; Anchoring and Mooring Systems.
